gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).
The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.
The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.
'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.

gaps.sentence: The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.

gaps.sentence: She explained the process ___ (PATIENT) to each visitor.
Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.
